The two offer-level candidates combine offer-level promotional linkage with an existential non-discount gift component. Unless the supplied classifications connect that same component to the promotion, mixed-purpose offers could be overincluded.

The circular's local distributor definition supports the SFC-authorised-fund scope. That scope must not be presented as the complete scope of paragraph 3.11, quoted in broader investment-product terms.

Code of Conduct paragraph 3.11 and the answer to FAQ question 1 dated 30 September 2010 are identified but not supplied externally. Supply their applicable versions to verify the complete gift standard; no dependency IDs can be assigned from this packet.

Gift classification, discount classification and attribution remain supplied judgments. The source says incentives may be gifts; guaranteed returns are not automatically gifts. Provider terminology in node.142f34016b300f5c110eb249 must identify the offeror rather than impose an additional funding or fulfilment requirement.

A negative gift result or compliance with the selected gift control grants no permission under section 103, disclosure duties or advertising rules. Conversely, statutory authorisation or exemption is not a gift exception.
Footnote 1 is supplied, contrary to the disclosure claim's uncertainty annotation. The narrow extracted duty is supported but does not exhaust the accompanying principal-loss disclosure.
